name: open-westeros
description: Community-built, Google Earth-style 3D atlas of the Known World

scripts.test: node --test tools/wiki/houses.test.mjs src/state/time.test.ts src/state/changes.test.ts src/houseGraph.test.ts src/declutter.test.ts src/measureUnits.test.ts tools/world/coast-refine.test.mjs tools/world/house-territories.test.mjs tools/blog/roads-graph.test.mjs tools/world/terrain/hydrology.test.mjs tools/world/river-orient.test.mjs tools/characters/qm-map.test.mjs src/globe/pathMath.test.ts
scripts.assets: node tools/world/consensus.mjs && node tools/sites/kingsLanding/plan.mjs && node tools/sites/kingsLanding/analyze.mjs && node tools/sites/kingsLanding/export-gis.mjs
scripts.wiki: node tools/wiki/scrape.mjs --places && node tools/wiki/place-info.mjs && node tools/wiki/scrape.mjs --sigils
scripts.characters: node tools/characters/qm-extract.mjs && node tools/characters/qm-map.mjs && node tools/characters/build.mjs && node tools/books/chapters.mjs && node tools/characters/legs-check.mjs --min 0.5
scripts.characters:wiki: node tools/wiki/scrape.mjs --characters && node tools/wiki/character-info.mjs && node tools/wiki/scrape.mjs --sigils
scripts.verify: npm run lore:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
